plan: Changed the list handler to keyset pagination with the tag filter in SQL, then added tests and docs in parallel.
rationale: Impact analysis showed the existing in-Python tag filter would make naive LIMIT paging return short or empty pages, so the filter moved into the query as part of the same change.
risks: Unbounded-list callers silently get the first page only.
trade_offs: Cursor in a header to keep the body shape.
assumptions: Ordering by id (creation order) is acceptable.
limitations: The per-note tag lookup (N+1) is unchanged.
